events.title: OpenAI expands Daybreak cybersecurity initiative with autonomous hacking capabilities
events.one_liner: On August 10, 2026, OpenAI expanded its Daybreak cybersecurity initiative with multiple new components. The company launched GPT-5.6-Cyber, a specialized cybersecurity-specific AI model designed to help security researchers and defenders identify software vulnerabilities. GPT-5.6-Cyber features fewer guardrails than standard OpenAI models, with reduced safety restrictions specifically intended for authorized vulnerability research and trusted security researchers. OpenAI introduced a two-tiered access system for Daybreak: Daybreak Blue for general defenders and Daybreak Red for authorized vulnerability researchers conducting security testing. The expansion included partnerships with 16 major cybersecurity vendors. This expansion came days after OpenAI delayed the release of its Astra model following tests that suggested it may have reached critical cybersecurity risk thresholds. The timing reflected broader industry concerns about AI agents demonstrating autonomous hacking capabilities, with multiple recent incidents of AI-powered cyber attacks documented by security researchers at conferences like Black Hat. The initiative positions defenders to use AI capabilities for identifying vulnerabilities before attackers can exploit them.

events.title: Anthropic shifts Claude Code to automatic mode by default for paid plans
events.one_liner: Anthropic announced on August 10, 2026 that it is making Claude Code's auto mode the default setting for Pro, Max, and Team paid plans, effective August 14, 2026. Previously, Claude Code required manual human approval for each command execution. Auto mode enables Claude Code to execute commands automatically with an AI-based classifier reviewing actions for safety, rather than requiring repeated human approval prompts. In internal testing, Anthropic found that auto mode blocked 89% of harmful or dangerous actions, compared to 14% caught by humans. The system has an 11% miss rate for detecting dangerous commands. Anthropic is implementing new safeguards against prompt injection attacks alongside this change. The shift aims to reduce user friction and overhead while improving security outcomes, allowing developers to work more continuously without frequent approval interruptions.

events.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide and integrates team into ChatGPT
events.one_liner: OpenAI has acquired NextSlide, an AI presentation startup founded by Ahmed Beshry. The acquisition became public in early August 2026, though the team had joined earlier in March 2026. NextSlide's product automatically turns prompts, notes, documents, or research into polished, editable presentations. The startup's entire team has been integrated into OpenAI to work on ChatGPT capabilities, expanding ChatGPT's visual presentation tools. The acquisition represents OpenAI's effort to build an office suite inside ChatGPT to compete with presentation tools like Gamma, Canva, and PowerPoint.

events.title: Payroll Pirates AiTM phishing campaign hijacks Microsoft 365 sessions
events.one_liner: Cybercriminals launched a widespread phishing campaign called "Payroll Pirates" using adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) tactics to hijack Microsoft 365 sessions and steal payroll and finance data. Arctic Wolf Labs identified the ongoing campaign targeting organizations in healthcare, education, manufacturing, and across the United States. The attackers use AiTM phishing infrastructure to compromise Microsoft 365 accounts despite multi-factor authentication (MFA) being in place. Once sessions are hijacked, the threat actors use residential proxies and access the Microsoft Graph API to enumerate and collect emails from payroll and finance mailboxes. The campaign is financially motivated, seeking to exfiltrate sensitive payroll and financial information for fraud purposes. The threat actor behind the campaign is linked to Storm-2755. The phishing campaign successfully bypasses traditional MFA protections by intercepting and proxying authentication flows between users and Microsoft 365 services.
